Schneider Electric is a leading Oem provider headquartered in Rueil-Malmaison. With over 1,000 employees across 4 manufacturing facilities, we deliver world-class RMA Management, AOI (Automated Optical Inspection), and Press-Fit Assembly services.

Our certifications include IATF 16949:2016, IATF 16949:2016, and ISO 9001:2015. We serve the aerospace, telecom, and aerospace industries.
